subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the highlighted word segment in the given sentence. If the sentence is grammatically correct, select ‘No correction’.

The boy **play **football since he has come from school.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. has been playing .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to an ongoing action that started in the past and continues in the present, indicated by the phrase "since he has come from school."
 
• To express such ongoing actions, the **present perfect continuous tense** is used.
 
• The structure of the present perfect continuous tense is **has/have been + verb-ing**.

Correct sentence: *The boy **has been playing** football since he has come from school*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Present Perfect Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** has/have + past participle.
 
• **Example:** He has completed his homework.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to actions that are completed in the past but have relevance to the present.
 
 
 
• **Past Continuous Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure:** was/were + verb-ing.
 
• **Example:** He was playing football when it started raining.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to actions that were ongoing at a specific time in the past.
